offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures single-wafer wet cleaning, electroplating, stress-free polishing, furnace and advanced packaging process equipment for semiconductor chipmakers. Sells mainly to wafer fabs and packaging houses, with large operations in China.

primary_products.value: single-wafer cleaning equipment; electroplating equipment; furnace equipment; stress-free polishing equipment; advanced packaging tools

primary_services.value: equipment installation and maintenance; spare parts and upgrades support

customer_segment.value: B2B: semiconductor wafer fabs, memory and logic chipmakers, advanced packaging houses

end_markets.value: semiconductor manufacturing; advanced packaging; memory and logic chips

revenue_model.value: product sales: semiconductor process equipment sold to chip manufacturers; service fees: spare parts, upgrades and maintenance services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds process tools from purchased components, sold to chipmakers, manufacturing in Shanghai and Korea

geography_served.value: global: China primarily, plus South Korea, Taiwan, US and other Asian markets

specialization.value: related lines: wet cleaning, plating, furnace, polishing and packaging tools for wafer fabrication

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales to semiconductor fabs and packaging customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: US export controls (BIS), China trade rules and environmental and safety regulations affect sales
